messages:
Ivy Zhang: hey, accepted the org invite but I only see public repos. trying to open eng-infra/runner and it 404s. also when I tried to set up 2FA GitHub offered passkey and my Pixel gave 'platform unsupported'. who do I bug?

onboarding-bot: welcome to Redwood! :tada: Common causes: invite sent to a different email, outside-collaborator role, or SSO/2FA not completed. Check https://docs.redwood.example/devex/github-access. If you want, ping @DevEx-Luca for a quick check.

DevEx-Luca: @Ivy Zhang what's your GitHub handle?

Ivy Zhang: ivyzh

DevEx-Luca: quick look: your membership shows as "outside collaborator" and sso_required: true. Do you remember if the invite went to an alias (ivy@personal.com vs ivy.zhang@redwood.com)?

Ivy Zhang: invite was to ivy.zhang@redwood.com, but my primary GitHub email is ivy@personal.com. I clicked accept though.

IT-Miguel: that mismatch can create outside-collab behavior if the invite linked to the personal account previously. Two things: 1) Add your work email to GitHub and verify it. 2) If still outside, we can convert you to a full org member from the admin console. Which would you prefer?

Ivy Zhang: i'll add the work email now. done and verified. still shows outside collaborator.

DevEx-Luca: ok hold — I can convert you. @IT-Miguel can you change membership type for ivyzh to member and trigger SSO invite?

IT-Miguel: on it. changing membership to member and re-sending SAML authorization. should be a few secs.

Ivy Zhang: I got an email from IdP to authorize SAML and it redirected to GitHub which asked me to enroll passkey. my Pixel 5 says "platform not supported" and the YubiKey I tried gave "no compatible authenticators".

SRE-Kate: older Android builds can be flaky for webauthn/passkeys. Quick unblock: enroll TOTP using an authenticator app (Authy/GA) and then finish SSO. We can later provision a hardware key if you want.

Ivy Zhang: enrolled TOTP and clicked authorize. GitHub shows me as member now but repo still 404 in browser.

DevEx-Luca: try: 1) logout github.com, 2) incognito, 3) visit https://github.com/orgs/redwood-inference and click authorize SAML (if prompted), 4) wait 30s and refresh the repo url.

Ivy Zhang: did incognito + re-login, repo page loads now. clone works but push gives: "remote: Permission to redwood-inference/runner.git denied to ivyzh. fatal: unable to access ... 403"

Raj: pushed perms for you to eng-infra-dev with write access a minute ago. 403 after team add usually means cached credentials or SSO not fully propagated. If you used a cached token, run `git credential-osxkeychain erase` (mac) or clear credential helper, then `gh auth login`.

Ivy Zhang: ran `gh auth login` and `git credential-manager erase`, now push succeeded. thanks!

IT-Miguel: created ticket RW-990 to track the passkey/platform incompatibility and device guidance for onboarding. We'll add a checklist item to recommend TOTP for older phones and a YubiKey request flow.

Ivy Zhang: awesome, thanks everyone! one more: where do I request a YubiKey?

IT-Miguel: file IT ticket RW-990 with subject "YubiKey request" or DM me and I'll attach it. welcome aboard :wave:

Ivy Zhang: thanks, really appreciate the quick help :smile:
